server: LabServer63 originally (main); amendment 1: local PC RTX 5080 16 GB (user decision, this batch only)
question: Does increasing the global ATO mixture rank from 8 to 16 (frozen WL74 G2 basis) make the learned W+UV intrinsic K more accurate at independent source positions, and does that justify the added model and runtime cost?
scope: bounded falsification of one complete design change (rank 8 -> 16 incl. the rank-dependent spatial output channels); not a rank-expansion adoption; it does not separate angular-basis quality from rank-dependent spatial capacity
operator: K_scatter[i,j,a,o,c] = d[i,a] sum_{r<M} A[r,a,c] T[i,j,r,c] O[r,o,c]; T = (W_e + sum_k U[j,k] V[i,k]) * mass / (sum W + sum V); A = softmax(in_logits, r), O = softmax(out_logits, o); M = 16; node rank TR = 16, 16 incoming / 64 outgoing bins, ballistic B, d = 1 - beta, first-exit semantics, passivity normalisation, geometry features and W+UV architecture unchanged

basis.rule: the G2 restart with the lowest final FITTING objective J_final (WL74 Stage 1 basis fit on S16-R fitting replicas 0-3) read from the basis files; WL74 Stage 1 held-out scores and Stage 2 development confirmation are not used
basis.precision: stored float64 logits rounded once to float32 model parameters; frozen (requires_grad False) during spatial fitting
basis.provenance_note: G2_r0 was initialised from the WL68 net_all_5902 basis with every mixture duplicated + N(0, 0.01) (WL74 init rule) and refitted

stage0.rank_dependent_parameters: edge[-1] Linear(128, M*C) (row r*C+c); node_head[-1] Linear(144, 2*TR*M*C + M*C) (U rows t*M*C+r*C+c, V rows TR*M*C + same, mass rows 2*TR*M*C + r*C+c); in_logits (M,16,C); out_logits (M,64,C)
stage0.state_dimensions: W (E, M, C), U (P, TR, M, C), V (P, TR, M, C): doubled at M = 16; A (M,16,C), O (M,64,C)
stage0.rank8_reproduction: rank75.TransportM(8) with the AR_5901 state == runtime.Transport: columns, coefficients, apply, column sums, runtime.full rel <= 1e-6; rank-generic objective == fit73 objective (J, L_sym term) rel <= 1e-6
stage0.rank16_embedding_test: mixture r <- rank-8 mixture r mod 8, logits repeated (softmax halves each copy): apply / predict rel <= 1e-5, column sums rel <= 1e-6 vs the rank-8 operator (correctness test only, not the initialisation)
stage0.initialisation: trunk (encoder, messages, src/dst/pair layers, edge and node_head hidden layers) = P_590x bitwise (the WL73 AR initialisation); rank-dependent final layers = P_590x rows of mixture r mod 8 (the duplication that defines G2_r0's restart-0 start); in/out logits = G2_r0; no new random channel. Chosen from the basis construction before any candidate metric.
stage0.physics_tests: zero input, positivity, linearity, column sums <= 1 + 1e-6, cache identity (r57_eval.physics) at rank 16 for the embedded, initial and perturbed networks on rest and pt0

optimizer.objective: J (WL68 objective, rank-generic ato74.objective_m) + 1.0 * L_sym (WL72 exact-symmetry consistency)
optimizer.training_data: S16-R fit_targets73.pt (fitting replicas 0-3), rest and pt0; WL72 pt0 symmetry-image geometries

controls.oracles: labelled source-specific oracles G0_r0 (fixed WL68 rank 8) and G2_r0 (rank 16): per-source T, never a transferable rule

stage2.data: S16-R training sources at rest / pt0 scored on held-out replicas 4-7 (eval73.load_refs); WL73 development groups (confirmation, removed, deformation) descriptive; passivity rest/pt0/cf3/cf2/te2/te0
stage2.provenance: recomputed AR_5901/5902 group bounds vs ~/rest_src73/eval/analysis.json and recomputed G0_r0/G2_r0 training scores vs ~/rest_ato74/stage1/scores.json (max relative difference of hi) <= tolerance, else STOP

gate.metric: worst-channel jackknife upper 95 % bound (hi) of the pooled group error, eval68 estimators
gate.capacity_rule: each A75 seed: con_coarse hi <= 0.8 x min over AR seeds on both TRAIN_NEW groups (the WL73 boundary training sources where rank-8 learned K sits at the fixed-basis oracle floor; meeting it requires going below the G0 floor)
gate.regression_rule: each A75 seed: hi <= 1.25 x max over AR seeds for every listed group/metric
gate.validity: each A75 seed: every passivity check passed and A/O bitwise equal to the frozen G2 basis
gate.pass: provenance passed AND both seeds pass capacity, regression and validity
gate.outcomes: FIT GATE PASSED -> Stage 3; INSUFFICIENT FIT -> stop before reference generation (analysis on training/development data, cost, export); PHYSICAL VALIDITY FAILURE -> stop; STOP (provenance) -> stop
gate.descriptive: G0 / G2 oracle values and the fraction of the AR -> G2-oracle gap closed (not part of the gate)

stage3.population: WL74 Stage 4 (frozen geometry-only in ato74_v1 / ports74.py before any WL74 evidence; references never generated by WL74)
stage3.pose_note: cf1 dent centre lies 4.4 mm from the pt0 training centre: DEF4 is a near-training-pose check, not broad unseen-geometry transfer
stage3.references: probes74.generate / bundle unchanged (WL57 fast walker, gates, 32M photons with 16M OOM fallback, K = 4, seeds 743000000 + g*1e6 + slot*1e4 + bin*100 + rep, rest 0 / cf1 1), 1,408 packets, written to ~/rest_rank75/refs; any failed packet gate stops
stage3.qualification: eval73 rule unchanged: abs signal/SE >= 10 per matrix, deformation >= 3; a group needs >= 4 qualified matrices, otherwise UNMEASURED
stage3.strata_note: the frozen population has no previously unrepresented (SV) source; that stratum is reported only from the WL73 development group UNS (Stage 2, already used in WL73/74 analysis)
stage3.evaluated: AR_5901, AR_5902, A75_5901, A75_5902 (finals) and every checkpoint @2000/6000/10000 of both (descriptive drift); learned scored on replicas 0-3 and, for the oracle comparison, 1-3
stage3.oracle: G0_r0 and G2_r0: per-source T fitted on replica 0 (float64 FISTA from 0.5/P, then the same budget again as a convergence check), scored on replicas 1-3 (WL74 Stage 2 arithmetic)

decision.far_rule: far = YES iff max over A75 seeds of con_coarse hi on BND4_FAR <= 0.8 x min over AR seeds AND < min over AR seeds of the lower 95 % bound (beyond statistical and seed uncertainty); NO iff min over A75 seeds > 0.8 x max over AR seeds; otherwise OVERLAP. near = the same on BND4_NEAR
decision.regression_rule: per group/metric: YES iff min over A75 seeds >= 1.25 x max over AR seeds; NO iff max over A75 < 1.25 x min over AR; otherwise OVERLAP
decision.classes: PHYSICAL VALIDITY FAILURE if any passivity check fails; INCONCLUSIVE if a primary group is unmeasured or far = OVERLAP; far = YES: TRANSFERABLE RANK-16 BENEFIT (far boundary) if no regression = YES (qualifier 'possible regression (overlap)' if any OVERLAP), else TRADE-OFF; far = NO: NO INDEPENDENT GENERALIZATION BENEFIT (training-only benefit), with LOCAL BENEFIT (BND4_NEAR contrast) if near = YES and 'with regression' if any regression = YES
decision.absolute_gates: WL59 gates reported separately per group and model: abs_coarse <= 0.10, abs_fine16 <= 0.15, con_coarse <= 0.25 (upper 95 %, every channel); DEF4 relative <= 0.35 and corr >= 0.90 (eval73 Qdef)

stage4.rule: descriptive analysis of the obtained evaluation data; no training, inference, selection or correction change
stage4.A: per matrix (replicas 1-3): AR vs G0 oracle, A75 vs G2 oracle, A75 vs G0; group pooled learned vs oracle
stage4.B: coarse-cell sub-position from rest material coordinates (index inside the 1 cm cell per varying axis; center / edge / corner), errors stratified (native / fine16 / coarse), Stage 4 and training sources
stage4.C: face / context labels; label-free invariants of the frozen learned operators under the 15 exact non-identity slab operations (D4 x z-flip): I1 angle-integrated spatial field (exact), I2 sorted per-incoming-bin totals and I3 native contrast norm (exact when the operation permutes bins; checked by the sorted ballistic budget rows); no orientation correction
stage4.D: per-source error vs distance to the S16-R sources (actual and exact images), rank 8 vs rank 16 at the same sources
stage4.E: checkpoints 2,000 / 6,000 / 10,000 / final on training (Stage 2) and Stage 4 groups; no selection

stage5.measured: parameters, angular parameters, W/U/V state floats, full coefficient rebuild from geometry, apply latency (64 lights / 1 light), peak GPU memory (same GPU, run alone at the end of the chain, median of repeats after warm-up); rank-independent geometry preparation (cf1 with ballistic B, once); training time / peak (run records, concurrency labelled); Stage 3 reference cost; G2 angular pretraining time
stage5.rule: the measured rank-16 / rank-8 ratios are reported; 'COMPUTATIONAL COST DOMINATES' is attached only when Stage 3 gives a transferable benefit and any listed ratio exceeds 2.0 (more than proportional to the rank doubling)

execution.chain: inputs (hash-checked copy of the frozen WL74 Stage 4 inputs) -> tests -> full-scale probe (non-evidence) -> two fits -> Stage 2 + gate -> [gate passed: references -> bundle -> Stage 3] -> analysis -> cost -> export; any failure stops; one detached setsid chain
execution.lanes_rule: probe both runs concurrently with the real configuration; two lanes iff both complete and the sum of peak reserved memory <= 0.85 x GPU memory, else one lane (re-probed alone); a failed single-lane probe stops
execution.dev_smoke: ~/rest_rank75_dev: 40-step fits, 5 FISTA oracle iterations, 0.5M-photon packets on dev_slots only, Stage 3 forced; no metric used

independence.stage3_labels: WL74 never generated Stage 4 references (no ~/rest_ato74/refs). The WL74 dev smoke (~/rest_ato74_dev) generated 0.5M-photon dev packets for this population and ran its forced 40-step dev path on them; no metric was read and nothing in WL74 or WL75 was chosen from them. WL75 does not read them.
independence.selection: basis by the fitting objective only; initialisation by construction; final iterates only; thresholds and decisions frozen in this file before any WL75 candidate metric or Stage 3 reference exists
independence.exclusions: Stage 4 ports exclude every previously scored source (WL66-72, S16-R, 29 WL73 confirmation ports) and all their exact images (ports74.py, re-asserted in test75)

prohibited: held-out labels for model or checkpoint selection

amendments.reason: LabServer63 was occupied by another project's jobs (TransGI, ~8 GB of 12 GB) and the first dev smoke failed its objective-identity test with a CUDA OOM; the user decided: 'this WL75 batch only runs locally' (default machine stays LabServer63).
amendments.change: Placement: the local PC (RTX 5080 16 GB, Windows-native torch 2.8 cu128 venv external/8dna26/.venv-cu128) instead of LabServer63 for every stage: tests, fits, Stage 2, Stage 3 references, Stage 3 evaluation, analysis and cost. Read-only inputs copied byte-for-byte from LabServer63 into the same directory names under the local home (~/rest_repr68, rest_cover71, rest_cmp72, rest_src73, rest_ato74; hashes of the protocol-listed files re-asserted by the tests and the inputs stage). Execution-only code changes: Unix-only 'resource'/'fcntl' stubs on Windows (common75, as WL72A and the T* smoke), a Python GPU sampler instead of bash, a Git Bash wrapper run75_local.sh without the GPU wait. No training, evaluation, threshold or decision rule changes.
amendments.consequences: Stage 3 references are generated on the local machine with the unchanged WL57 walker (the training/development references and the AR controls were produced on LabServer63): a cross-machine reference set, labelled; the walker ran locally in WL72A validation with passing physical gates. AR controls and oracles are re-evaluated locally and must reproduce the archived LabServer63 values within the 1e-3 provenance tolerance. Stage 5 costs are measured on the RTX 5080 for both ranks (comparable within this batch, not with LabServer63 timings). Fit seconds of the WL73 AR controls (LabServer63, 2 lanes) are not comparable with the local A75 fit seconds.
